adds.title: United Nations Human Rights Council - June 2011 SOGI resolution vote
adds.summary: On 17 June 2011 the UN Human Rights Council adopted by 23 votes to 19 its first resolution on sexual orientation and gender identity expressing grave concern at acts of violence and discrimination committed against individuals because of sexual orientation and gender identity including transgender people and establishing a formal UN process to document abuses by commissioning a global report on discrimination including discriminatory laws and acts of violence and calling for a panel discussion on discriminatory laws, practices and acts of violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender people.
